Lord '''Orban''' is a [[Hunter of the Horn]].

== Appearance ==
He is young with dark hair. His horse is named [[Lion (horse)|Lion]].{{ref/book|3|34}}

==Activities==
Lord Orban and Lord [[Gann]] are Hunters of the Horn, believing it to be in the [[Forest of Shadows]].{{ref/book|3|35}} He and Lord Gann, with their retainers, come upon two [[Aiel]]; [[Sarien]] and [[Gaul]]. Sarien is killed and Gaul is captured. Several of the Hunters' men are wounded or killed, and the Hunters themselves are injured.{{ref/book|3|34}} When [[Moiraine Damodred]], [[Lan Mandragoran]], [[Perrin Aybara]] and [[Loial]] stop at the [[Wayland's Forge]] inn in [[Remen]], Lord Orban is bragging about his and Gann's exploits. According to Orban, there was a band of Aiel which they killed and only few hurts or deaths on their side.{{ref/book|3|33}} Orban continues to brag about his "exploits."{{ref/book|3|34}}{{ref/book|3|35}}
